methodhelp.ar1_global: Global test under the AR1 null, nominal level 5%, over all positive frequencies. Requires 64–1024 regularly spaced, non-constant samples. Only internal LOWESS is replayed in reference simulations; other preprocessing must preserve the model assumptions.
ui.ar1_reject: Rejects the specified AR1 noise null; not individual peak confirmation
ui.ar1_not_reject: Insufficient evidence to reject the specified noise null
ui.ar1_inconclusive: Empty candidate parameter set; significance unavailable
warning.ar1_global_scope: Assumes the incoming series is stationary Gaussian AR1. Internal LOWESS can be replayed; other ancestor processing is not replayed. This is a single-record global test, not FDR, individual-peak probability or proof of an astronomical cycle. Do not select significant results by trying different seeds.
warning.ar1_empty_set: Empty candidate parameter set; conservatively returns p=1 and marks the test inconclusive.
warning.ar1_cache: Reference cache unavailable or not saved; this calculation remains usable, but later runs may regenerate it.
diagnostic.AR1_GLOBAL_FAILED.summary: AR1 global test did not complete ({samples} samples, {simulations} analysis simulations).
diagnostic.AR1_GLOBAL_FAILED.suggestion: Supports 64–1024 uniformly spaced, nonconstant samples. Read technical details; no automatic truncation, sorting or resampling. Initial simulation is slower; cancellation is supported.

warning.astronomy_interpolated: Spacing below 1 ka interpolates the native La2004 table; it does not add independent orbital information.

diagnostic.ASTRONOMY_INTEGRATION.suggest: Check the seasonal interval and parameters; no partial output was published.
methodhelp.clean_series: Sorts X/Y pairs by increasing X and merges duplicate X values using the selected rule. No resampling.
methodhelp.affine: Y′ = scale × Y + offset; X is unchanged.
methodhelp.preprocess: Sorts by X, merges duplicate X values and resamples at the specified interval. Missing values follow the import policy.
methodhelp.insolation_source: Daily mean top-of-atmosphere insolation. Calendar dates use a fixed 365-day year with the vernal equinox at noon on March 21.
methodhelp.seasonal_insolation: Seasonal mean insolation, integrated energy and duration. Fixed 365-day calendar, with the vernal equinox at noon on March 21; the end date is excluded.
parameterhelp.fraction: Fraction of samples in a local LOWESS window, not a physical X-axis width.
parameterhelp.iterations: 0: ordinary LOWESS. Positive values enable robust reweighting; 5 is a common rLOWESS setting.
parameterhelp.nfft: 0 uses the input length. Zero padding refines the frequency grid but does not improve physical spectral resolution.
parameterhelp.fmax_ratio: Fraction of the Nyquist frequency to publish. Background fitting and peak detection still use the full spectrum.
parameterhelp.peak_prominence: Absolute prominence in PSD units. 0 disables the absolute threshold; the relative threshold can still apply. Peak detection does not establish statistical significance.
parameterhelp.peak_distance: Minimum index distance between retained peaks. Stronger prominence wins, then height.
parameterhelp.peak_width: Width at half prominence, measured in frequency bins. Zero disables this filter.
parameterhelp.peak_height: Minimum PSD at the peak, independent of the significance curves. Zero retains all nonnegative candidates.
parameterhelp.peak_radius: 0 searches the full spectrum. A positive radius limits baseline search to that many bins on each side, changing prominence and width.
parameterhelp.interpolation: Linear is the default. Cubic is a natural cubic spline; Akima is a local piecewise cubic method. No method is silently forced.
parameterhelp.duplicate_policy: Duplicate means exactly equal X, not repeated Y. Average combines Y; first/last refer to original input order.
parameterhelp.skip_invalid_rows: When enabled, rows with empty, nonnumeric, NaN or infinite selected X/Y are dropped and counted; otherwise import fails. Completely blank lines are ignored. Preview and execution share this reader.
parameterhelp.age_start_ka: Age before J2000, positive into the past; not BP relative to 1950.
parameterhelp.age_end_ka: Older end of the interval, at most 50000 ka before J2000.
parameterhelp.age_step_ka: La2004 native spacing is 1 ka. Finer spacing interpolates; seasonal integration allows at most 20000 ages.
parameterhelp.latitude_deg: North is positive, south negative; both poles ±90° are supported.
parameterhelp.solar_longitude_deg: 0° vernal equinox, 90° June solstice, 180° autumnal equinox, 270° December solstice.
parameterhelp.solar_constant: Radiation at 1 AU. Default 1365 W/m² is explicit and adjustable.
parameterhelp.season_basis: Choose solar longitude or Gregorian month lengths without leap days. The 365 calendar slots span 365.24219876 24-hour days; equinox is fixed at March 21 noon. This is not a historical Gregorian reconstruction.
parameterhelp.month_start: Month 1–12; February has 28 days in the declared fixed calendar.
parameterhelp.day_start: Daily task evaluates the chosen date at noon. Seasonal task starts at midnight.
parameterhelp.day_end: Midnight at the end date, excluded. June 1 to September 1 includes June–August. Same dates mean a full year; earlier end dates wrap forward.
parameterhelp.season_start_deg: Forward integration in solar longitude with Kepler time weighting, not an unweighted longitude average.
parameterhelp.season_end_deg: End <= start wraps forward; equal bounds mean a complete year.
ui.heatmap_mapping_note: Logarithmic colors hide non-positive values; source data are unchanged.
ui.heatmap_contour_note: Local 95% significance, not a whole-map test; the cone of influence marks edge effects.
ui.heatmap_no_positive: This heatmap has no positive values for logarithmic color mapping.
ui.heatmap_contour_invalid: The significance grid is invalid or its coordinates do not match the heatmap; no boundary was drawn.
ui.heatmap_contour_dense: Contours too dense to draw; zoom in to inspect a smaller region.
ui.heatmap_contour_missing: No significance ratio is available for this output.
ui.heatmap_contour_none: The current grid does not cross threshold 1.
ui.heatmap_contour_reduced: Small contours may be omitted in the reduced preview.
ui.heatmap_masked: Log display leaves %1 non-positive pixels blank.
ui.preview_choose_input: No input selected for this workflow
ui.preview_outputs_hint: Output selection; related curves are displayed together.
ui.preview_reduced: Reduced preview; calculations use full data
methodhelp.gaussian_filter: Uniform sampling required. Removes the mean; band edges are half-power points. Gaussian zero-pads before filtering.
methodhelp.taner_filter: Uniform sampling required. Removes the mean; uses an N-point periodic filter and a separate amplitude envelope.
methodhelp.hilbert_envelope: Envelope of the selected parent output; no filtering is inserted. Narrow-band signals give the clearest amplitude interpretation.
methodhelp.insolation_map: Latitude–age map of daily mean insolation at a specified solar longitude or 365-day calendar date, using La2004.
parameterhelp.lower_frequency: Cycles per X unit (e.g. 1/ka). Require 0 < lower < upper < 0.5 / spacing. Values are not periods.
parameterhelp.upper_frequency: The amplitude gain is 1/sqrt(2) at both band edges; the corresponding power gain is 1/2.
parameterhelp.rolloff_exponent: Uses c = 10^q in the supplied Acycle corrected-bandpass-v2 formula. Default q=12; this value is not dB/octave.
parameterhelp.hilbert_remove_mean: Off matches hilbert(input). On computes the envelope of input minus its mean. Band-pass outputs are already demeaned before filtering.
parameterhelp.latitude_start_deg: North is positive and south negative. The southern boundary must be smaller than the northern boundary.
parameterhelp.latitude_step_deg: At most 361 latitudes, 20000 ages and 2000000 cells. A non-integral final interval is omitted.
warning.filter_endpoints: Finite-record filtering/envelopes can have endpoint artifacts. Inspect endpoints; a sharp pass band does not remove boundary uncertainty.
warning.hilbert_interpretation: The envelope is the modulus of the finite-block analytic signal. For broad-band mixtures it is not the amplitude of a unique physical cycle.
diagnostic.FILTER_BAND.summary: Invalid pass band; Nyquist frequency is {nyquist}.
diagnostic.FILTER_BAND.suggestion: Use positive frequencies in inverse X units, with lower < upper < Nyquist. Add resampling explicitly if needed.
diagnostic.FILTER_BUDGET.summary: Filter input or FFT length exceeds its memory budget.
diagnostic.FILTER_BUDGET.suggestion: Gaussian supports up to 262144 samples with its 10× padding; Taner/Hilbert up to 1000000. Reduce the interval or explicitly resample.
diagnostic.FILTER_FAILED.suggestion: Inspect the detailed parameters, input range and numerical-backend message.
diagnostic.INSOLATION_MAP_GRID.suggestio: Choose at least two increasing latitudes between −90° and 90°, with a positive interval.
diagnostic.INSOLATION_MAP_BUDGET.summary: The requested insolation map exceeds the supported grid or has fewer than two ages.
diagnostic.INSOLATION_MAP_BUDGET.suggest: Use at most 361 latitudes, 20000 ages and 2000000 cells; increase the spacing if necessary.
methodhelp.eccentricity_source: Orbital eccentricity. La2010 covers 0–249999 ka and ZB covers 0–300000 ka; table coverage does not imply reliable orbital phase throughout.
methodhelp.precession_tilt_source: Obliquity, climatic precession and precession angle. Defaults: Ed=1, Td=1; NOAA PT tables are supported. These tables do not provide all orbital elements required for insolation.
parameterhelp.eccentricity_solution: La2010 native spacing: 1 ka; ZB: 1.6 ka. Only eccentricity is supplied; no tilt/precession is borrowed from other solutions. Treat phases earlier than ~50 Ma (La2010) or ~66 Ma (ZB) with caution.
parameterhelp.pt_table_path: Leave empty for embedded Ed=1, Td=1. Download other tables from NOAA study 35174 and retain PT.DeX.XXXXTdY.YYYY.dat filenames. Native times are irregular; scalar values are interpolated on the output age grid. Clear the path to restore the default.
parameterhelp.orbit_start_ka: Positive age into the past, in ka before J2000; not BP relative to 1950.
parameterhelp.orbit_end_ka: Last data ages: La2010 249999 ka; ZB 300000 ka; PT 100000 ka. Requests outside the selected table fail; no extrapolation.
parameterhelp.orbit_step_ka: Uniform output age grid, at most one million samples. Linear scalar interpolation; shortest-arc axial-angle interpolation. Finer output adds no independent orbital information; coarse output can alias and is not automatically filtered.
progress.orbital_table: Reading and verifying the orbital table
warning.orbital_resampling: Output is interpolated on the requested age grid. Finer spacing adds no information; coarse sampling can alias. Native spacing and provenance are recorded in the result.
warning.orbital_deep_time: The requested ages exceed the solution’s phase reference interval. Numerical coverage is not a unique, precisely known orbital history.
warning.pt_model: PT results depend on dynamical ellipticity Ed and tidal dissipation Td. Coverage to 100 Ma does not guarantee phases throughout that interval. Axial precession is not perihelion longitude.
warning.pt_external: The local PT table was checked for format and range and its SHA-256 recorded. A filename alone cannot authenticate provenance; retain the official original file.
diagnostic.ORBITAL_DATA.summary: Orbital data could not be read or verified
diagnostic.ORBITAL_DATA.suggestion: Rebuild the complete project for embedded tables. For local PT data check the path, original filename and complete four-column NOAA study 35174 file. See error details.
diagnostic.ORBITAL_RANGE.summary: Requested age is outside this orbital table
diagnostic.ORBITAL_RANGE.suggestion: Adjust the end age to maximum_age_ka in the error details. The program neither extrapolates nor substitutes another solution.
diagnostic.ORBITAL_GRID.summary: Orbital age grid is invalid or too large
diagnostic.ORBITAL_GRID.suggestion: Use increasing ages, positive spacing and 2–1000000 samples. Shorten the interval or increase spacing.
methodhelp.evolution_fft: One-sided power spectral density in complete moving windows. X must be strictly increasing and regularly spaced. No per-window normalization or significance test.
methodhelp.evolution_mtm: Adaptive MTM spectra in complete moving windows. The heatmap describes power variation with position; no whole-map significance test is provided.
methodhelp.select_interval: Keeps or removes X/Y samples in a closed interval, preserving row order. No interpolation or gap closure.
methodhelp.demean: Subtracts the arithmetic mean from Y; X and units are unchanged.
methodhelp.standardize: Subtracts the mean from Y and divides by the selected standard deviation to obtain a dimensionless series. Not defined for constant series.
methodhelp.sampling_check: Checks X ordering, duplicates, regular spacing and large gaps. Preserves the input series; detail table limited to 4096 rows.
parameterhelp.evo_window: At least 8 samples and no longer than the input. Window span is (L−1)×spacing; Fourier duration is L×spacing.
parameterhelp.evo_step: 1 to window length. Only complete windows are computed; any unused tail is reported.
parameterhelp.evo_nfft: 0 uses the window length. An explicit value must be at least the window length. Padding refines the frequency grid, not physical resolution.
parameterhelp.evo_trend: Each window removes its mean or fitted linear trend before spectral estimation.
parameterhelp.evo_frequency_ratio: Fraction of Nyquist to publish. At least two frequency bins must remain. MTM weighting still uses the full frequency range.
parameterhelp.evo_nw: NW=1 or 1.25–32, and NW < window/2. Tapers: 2 at NW=1, otherwise round(2×NW)−1.
parameterhelp.evo_taper: Periodic Hann or rectangular taper, normalized by its squared-energy sum for PSD units.
parameterhelp.interval_lower: Uses the current X-axis unit; the lower bound is included.
parameterhelp.interval_upper: Uses the current X-axis unit; the upper bound is included and must not be below the lower bound.
parameterhelp.gap_factor: Flags positive adjacent intervals greater than this multiple of their median. A flag does not by itself prove a sedimentary hiatus.
warning.evolution_descriptive: The power map has no significance test; mean_spectrum averages window PSDs, not the full-record estimate.
warning.evolution_unconverged: Some MTM windows reached the adaptive iteration limit; see the report count.
warning.selection_gap: Removing samples may create gaps; downstream methods still check their own sampling requirements.
warning.sampling_unordered: X is not strictly increasing; the original data is retained unchanged.
warning.sampling_nonuniform: X is not uniformly spaced at relative tolerance 1e−6. No resampling was performed.
warning.sampling_gap: Large positive sampling intervals were found. These are data-quality flags, not a hiatus interpretation.
diagnostic.EVOLUTION_BUDGET.summary: Evolutionary spectrum exceeds the work or memory budget.
diagnostic.EVOLUTION_BUDGET.suggestion: Increase the step, reduce window/FFT length, or select a shorter input interval. Limits: one million input samples, 20000 windows, two million output cells.
diagnostic.EVOLUTION_PARAMETERS.suggesti: Check window ≤ input, 1 ≤ step ≤ window, FFT length ≥ window and the NW/frequency bounds.
diagnostic.EVOLUTION_FAILED.summary: Evolutionary spectrum could not be computed.
diagnostic.EVOLUTION_FAILED.suggestion: Inspect the numerical details and input scale. The task did not produce a valid result.
diagnostic.SERIES_BUDGET.summary: Series exceeds the one-million-sample task limit.
diagnostic.SERIES_BUDGET.suggestion: Select a shorter input interval before running this task.
diagnostic.STANDARDIZE_CONSTANT.summary: A constant series cannot be standardized.
diagnostic.STANDARDIZE_CONSTANT.suggesti: Its standard deviation is zero; use demean if a zero series is intended.
diagnostic.SELECTION_INTERVAL.summary: The lower X bound must not exceed the upper bound.
diagnostic.SELECTION_INTERVAL.suggestion: Enter finite bounds in the current X-axis unit.
diagnostic.SELECTION_EMPTY.summary: No samples remain after interval selection.
diagnostic.SELECTION_EMPTY.suggestion: Check the bounds, X units, and whether keep or remove is selected.
parameterhelp.smooth_window: Odd, at most 501 and no larger than the input. A point-count window. Moving mean clips edges; SG fits the first/last full window at the edges.
parameterhelp.smooth_degree: 0–5 and smaller than the window. Requires uniform sampling; default degree 2. Smoothing only, without differentiation.
parameterhelp.psd_window: At least 8 samples and no larger than the input. Complete segments only; no automatic shortening or edge padding.
parameterhelp.psd_overlap: Must be smaller than the segment length. Default 128 of 256 samples (50%); check this value after changing the segment length.
parameterhelp.psd_nfft: 0 uses record/segment length. Explicit values cannot be shorter; maximum 262144. Zero padding densifies the grid, not the physical resolution.
parameterhelp.psd_taper: One-sided physical PSD normalized by the sum of squared window weights; periodic Hann by default.
parameterhelp.psd_trend: FFT detrends the full record; Welch detrends each segment before estimating its spectrum.
warning.smoothing_changes_signal: Smoothing alters amplitudes and frequency content; it is not a significance test or confidence interval.
warning.smoothing_point_window: Nonuniform sampling: the moving average uses neighboring points; its physical X span varies.
warning.psd_descriptive: Physical PSD without significance thresholds or a peak index. Use MTM for the existing detected-frequency search.
diagnostic.SIGNAL_BUDGET.summary: The sample, window or work budget was exceeded.
diagnostic.SIGNAL_BUDGET.suggestion: Smoothing: at most 501 window points, one million samples and 100 million products. Spectra: FFT at most 262144, segments at most 20000. Select a shorter interval or reduce the window/FFT size.
diagnostic.SIGNAL_PARAMETERS.summary: The smoothing or spectral parameters are incompatible.
diagnostic.SIGNAL_PARAMETERS.suggestion: Check odd smoothing window and degree < window; spectral segments >= 8 and <= input, overlap < segment, and FFT length >= record/segment.
diagnostic.SIGNAL_FAILED.suggestion: Inspect diagnostic details and the input magnitude; no valid output was produced.
ui.catalog_interaction_hint: Click to expand categories; double-click or drag to add a task.
ui.drag_task_hint: Drop on a compatible Add task slot
ui.drag_source_hint: Drop on blank canvas or the start card
parameterhelp.ls_min_frequency: In inverse X units. 0 uses 1/record span. Uses the actual uneven X coordinates, without interpolation or sorting; at least 5 samples.
parameterhelp.ls_max_frequency: 0 uses 0.5/median adjacent spacing. This is a search heuristic, not a strict Nyquist limit for uneven sampling. A custom upper limit may be larger or smaller.
parameterhelp.ls_samples_per_peak: Spacing is 1/(record span × density), default 5. A denser search does not increase physical resolution. At most 65536 frequencies and 50 million sample-frequency pairs. Output is normalized fit power (0–1), not PSD or significance probability.
parameterhelp.butter_cutoff: In inverse X units; uniform sampling required. Cutoff/Nyquist must be 0.0001–0.9999. Gain is 1/sqrt(2) at the single-pass cutoff and 0.5 after both passes. The response curve shows the combined amplitude gain.
parameterhelp.butter_order: 1–10, default 4. Two passes double the effective order. Each end uses 3×(order+1) points of odd reflection; the record must be longer. Low-pass preserves DC; finite-record edge effects remain.
warning.lomb_normalization: Equal-weight floating-mean fit; power is the fractional residual reduction relative to a constant model. It is not PSD, confidence or false-alarm probability.
warning.lomb_auto_frequency: Automatic upper frequency is 0.5/median spacing: a search convention, not a strict Nyquist limit for uneven data. Check the band against your scientific target.
warning.lomb_rank: Some frequencies have rank-deficient harmonic columns. Fits use the identifiable subspace; completely degenerate bins are zero. Counts are recorded in the report.
warning.butterworth_boundary: Forward-backward filtering uses odd reflection and steady initial states. Edge effects remain, especially when the cutoff period approaches the record length.
warning.butterworth_cutoff: Cutoff is defined for one pass; combined amplitude gain at cutoff is 0.5 (about −6 dB). Inspect the amplitude-response output.
diagnostic.SPECTRAL_EXTENSION_BUDGET.sum: Input or frequency grid exceeds the computation budget.
diagnostic.SPECTRAL_EXTENSION_BUDGET.sug: For Lomb–Scargle, narrow the frequency interval or lower grid density: at most 65536 frequencies and 50 million sample-frequency pairs. Filtering allows one million samples. Data are not silently reduced.
diagnostic.SPECTRAL_EXTENSION_PARAMETERS: Frequency, record length or filter order is incompatible with the data.
Check the details and parameter help. Lomb–Scargle needs a positive nonempty frequency band; Butterworth requires more than 3×(order+1) samples.
diagnostic.SPECTRAL_EXTENSION_FAILED.sum: Spectral estimation or filtering could not complete.
diagnostic.SPECTRAL_EXTENSION_FAILED.sug: Inspect the diagnostic details and check data, frequency range and parameters.
diagnostic.LOMB_NO_VARIANCE.summary: The data have no usable variance for normalized Lomb–Scargle.
diagnostic.LOMB_NO_VARIANCE.suggestion: A constant series has no identifiable periodic variation. Choose varying data or check column selection and upstream operations.
diagnostic.BUTTERWORTH_CUTOFF.summary: Butterworth cutoff is unsuitable for this sampling interval; Nyquist is {nyquist}.
diagnostic.BUTTERWORTH_CUTOFF.suggestion: Use inverse X units. Cutoff/Nyquist must be within 0.0001–0.9999. Sampling intervals are not changed automatically.
parameterhelp.chrono_depth_unit: Actual unit of input X, default m. Must match nonempty input metadata; otherwise this explicit declaration is used with a warning.
parameterhelp.chrono_age_unit: Default ka (1000 years). Used for the first age and output; for Apply age model it is also the unit of the control-table age column, not inferred from its header.
parameterhelp.chrono_age_reference: Records the reference only; no epoch shift is applied. BP1950 and J2000 use their named epochs; relative is user-defined. Age increases with depth. Unspecified is not assumed to be before present.
parameterhelp.chrono_rate_unit: Y must be a positive sedimentation rate, default cm/ka. Existing metadata must match; kyr/ka and Myr/Ma aliases are accepted. Zero/negative rates cannot encode hiatuses or erosion here.
parameterhelp.chrono_first_age: Assigned to the FIRST input depth, default 0 in the selected age unit; not automatically tied to depth zero.
parameterhelp.chrono_rate_rule: Default left-constant: each interval uses Δt=Δz/r_left; final rate is validated but unused. Linear-rate mode integrates 1/r exactly for a linearly varying rate; it is not the reciprocal of a mean rate.
parameterhelp.chrono_model_file: Choose a depth–age table with at least two rows, including CSV exported by Sedimentation rate to age model. Default columns 1 and 2; max 4 MiB/100000 controls. Both columns must increase strictly; no automatic cleanup.
parameterhelp.chrono_model_depth_unit: Unit of the control-table depth column, converted to the input depth unit. The age column uses the Age unit setting.
parameterhelp.chrono_delimiter: Uses the normal import parser: automatic, comma, tab or whitespace. Blank lines and # comments are ignored.
parameterhelp.chrono_header: Auto detection examines the selected columns. Yes consumes the first row; No parses it as data. Invalid numeric rows fail rather than being skipped.
parameterhelp.chrono_depth_column: One-based control-table depth column; must differ from the age column.
parameterhelp.chrono_age_column: One-based control-table age column. Uncertainty columns are not interpreted as confidence intervals.
parameterhelp.chrono_boundary: Default rejects uncovered data without deleting rows. Explicit linear extrapolation extends endpoint secants and reports the count. No automatic resampling follows.
warning.chronology_deterministic: Deterministic age conversion: no age uncertainty estimate or geological validation of the controls.
warning.chronology_left_rate: Each interval uses its left rate; the final rate is validated as positive but not integrated.
warning.chronology_declared_units: Input units are missing; the explicitly selected task units were used. Check their physical meaning.
warning.chronology_no_resampling: Only X is converted; Y and sample count are unchanged. Resulting ages may be irregular; resample explicitly if a later method requires it.
warning.chronology_control_snapshot: The controls and file hash used are retained. Later executions reread that path; use preview Recalculate after external edits.
warning.chronology_extrapolated: Linear extrapolation was used; see the report for its sample count. Extrapolation adds no age constraints.
diagnostic.CHRONOLOGY_UNIT.summary: Input units conflict with task settings.
diagnostic.CHRONOLOGY_UNIT.suggestion: Check import and task units; do not mistake time for depth or an arbitrary signal for sedimentation rate.
diagnostic.CHRONOLOGY_SHAPE.summary: Age conversion requires at least two valid pairs.
diagnostic.CHRONOLOGY_SHAPE.suggestion: Check input length, controls and parameters.
diagnostic.CHRONOLOGY_DEPTH_ORDER.summar: Depth must strictly increase without duplicates.
diagnostic.CHRONOLOGY_DEPTH_ORDER.sugges: Inspect the point number; explicitly clean/sort data if appropriate. This task never edits rows automatically.
diagnostic.CHRONOLOGY_AGE_ORDER.summary: Control ages must strictly increase with depth.
diagnostic.CHRONOLOGY_AGE_ORDER.suggesti: Check reversals, repeated ages, selected columns and age direction; hiatuses/erosion need a separate model.
diagnostic.CHRONOLOGY_RATE_POSITIVE.summ: Every sedimentation rate must be finite and positive.
diagnostic.CHRONOLOGY_RATE_POSITIVE.sugg: Includes the final row; check units, zeros, negatives and invalid values.
diagnostic.CHRONOLOGY_COVERAGE.summary: Input depth lies outside age-control coverage.
diagnostic.CHRONOLOGY_COVERAGE.suggestio: Check depth units, extend controls, select a covered interval or explicitly enable linear extrapolation.
diagnostic.CHRONOLOGY_NUMERIC.summary: Age/rate exceeds numeric range or loses resolvable strict ordering.
diagnostic.CHRONOLOGY_NUMERIC.suggestion: Check units, extreme rates, very large age offsets and tiny intervals; Inf/NaN or flattened ages are not returned.
diagnostic.CHRONOLOGY_BUDGET.summary: Age conversion exceeds current resource limits.
diagnostic.CHRONOLOGY_BUDGET.suggestion: At most one million input points; control tables at most 4 MiB/100000 rows. Select the needed range first.
diagnostic.CHRONOLOGY_PARAMETERS.suggest: Inspect details, units and parameter help.
diagnostic.CHRONOLOGY_MODEL_FILE.suggest: Choose a control table in step settings; a model CSV exported by the rate task is supported.
diagnostic.CHRONOLOGY_COLUMNS.summary: Depth and age columns must differ.
diagnostic.CHRONOLOGY_COLUMNS.suggestion: Select different numeric columns using one-based column numbers.
parameterhelp.target_age_ma: 0–4000 million years before present; default 300 Ma. Waltham (2015) envelope model, not an orbital phase solution.
parameterhelp.target_component: Obliquity and four climatic-precession components vary with age. Five eccentricity frequency envelopes are fixed approximations from Table 1.
parameterhelp.cycle_period_source: Manual by default. Model midpoint uses the selected Waltham envelope midpoint, converted from ka to the Age unit. It is not a measured period.
parameterhelp.cycle_period: Default 41 in Age unit (default ka). One full cycle between consecutive selected peaks OR troughs, never alternating peaks and troughs.
parameterhelp.cycle_extremum: Choose peaks or troughs of a suitable signal; filter explicitly beforehand if needed. Flat tops/bottoms count once, at the central sample (left of two central samples). Endpoints are excluded.
parameterhelp.cycle_min_relief: Default 0 in Y units. Peak height above the higher adjacent inter-peak valley; troughs use the inverted signal. This is not global peak prominence.
parameterhelp.cycle_min_distance: Default 0 in Input depth unit. Retain stronger local relief first; ties prefer earlier markers. Equality is allowed. Suppression changes cycle counts and cannot detect missing cycles.
parameterhelp.cycle_first_age_mode: Default is one full period, matching Acycle Build Age Model. Specify an absolute or relative first age explicitly when a dated marker is available.
parameterhelp.cycle_first_age: Age of the FIRST selected marker, in Age unit. It is not the first input row. Ages increase with depth.
parameterhelp.cycle_extend_ends: Off by default: model contains selected markers only. When enabled, extend the first/last age-depth secants to the input ends; this adds no independent age constraint.
warning.target_envelope: These are model envelopes, not calibrated 95% confidence intervals, orbital phases or a statistical detection of astronomical forcing.
warning.target_eccentricity: Eccentricity periods use fixed Table 1 frequency envelopes; geological age does not change these approximations.
warning.cycle_count_assumption: Each consecutive selected marker is assigned one full cycle. Missing or double cycles are not inferred. Tuning imposes periodicity and is not independent evidence for astronomical forcing.
warning.cycle_model_midpoint: Only the target midpoint sets the duration. Its model envelope is recorded, but not propagated as an age uncertainty.
diagnostic.TARGET_PERIOD.summary: Cannot evaluate the astronomical period model.
diagnostic.TARGET_PERIOD.suggestion: Use a finite age in 0–4000 Ma and a supported component; inspect the detailed numeric message.
diagnostic.CYCLE_ANCHORS.summary: Fewer than two usable same-phase cycle markers.
diagnostic.CYCLE_ANCHORS.suggestion: Use at least three paired samples with at least two interior peaks or troughs; inspect thresholds, input range and any prior filtering. Constant data cannot define cycles.
parameterhelp.coco_target: Manual periods by default. Optional Waltham midpoints select E405, E124, E95, obliquity, P1, P2 and P4; this does not load a La2004 time series.
parameterhelp.coco_periods: Enter 2–16 positive periods separated by commas or spaces. Defaults 405,125,95,41,24,22,19 ka are a modern example; use age-appropriate periods for older records. All frequencies must be below the band limit.
parameterhelp.coco_powers: Positive powers, one per period, not amplitudes. Defaults 1,1,1,0.64,0.36,0.36,0.36 correspond to amplitudes 1,1,1,0.8,0.6,0.6,0.6. No adaptive fitting.
parameterhelp.coco_rate_min: Positive sedimentation rate. X must be increasing, uniformly sampled depth; no automatic sorting or resampling.
parameterhelp.coco_rate_max: Upper bound; rates are minimum plus integer multiples of the step. No off-grid endpoint is appended.
parameterhelp.coco_rate_step: At most 2000 rates. The full band and every target must be resolved; excluded candidates remain in the diagnostic table.
parameterhelp.coco_max_frequency: Default 0.06. Compare non-DC bins up to this limit; short ancient precession periods may require a higher limit. The full band must lie within candidate Nyquist.
parameterhelp.coco_padding: 1–4; FFT length is the next power of two at least factor times N. Padding refines the grid, not physical resolution.
parameterhelp.coco_detrend: Default removes only the mean; none or linear detrending is optional. Apply the same rule to data and target bases. No red-noise removal or implicit LOWESS.
warning.coco_descriptive: Descriptive spectral matching only: no significance test or rate confidence interval. High correlation does not prove astronomical forcing. The best candidate is not a confirmed rate; no age model is created.
warning.coco_target: Fixed-weight target averages sine/cosine powers to avoid arbitrary phase interference. This is not a pointwise replica of all Acycle options; no adaptive weights or red-noise subtraction. Nearby targets may remain unresolved from each other; this count is not a detection count.
warning.coco_exclusions: Some rates were excluded. Status: 0 eligible, 1 band above Nyquist, 2 insufficient resolution/bins, 3 constant spectrum. Correlations are valid only where eligible=1; other zeros are placeholders.
progress.coco_scan: Scanning rates and comparing target spectra
diagnostic.COCO_BUDGET.suggestion: Narrow the rate grid, increase its step, reduce padding/simulations, or increase the window step. At most 131072 samples per window; input/cache/work budgets also apply. See details.
diagnostic.COCO_NO_SCORE.suggestion: Check variance, sampling and record length against the full target band; see details. No automatic resampling or removal of targets.
diagnostic.COCO_PARAMETERS.summary: Invalid COCO parameters or numeric range.
diagnostic.COCO_PARAMETERS.suggestion: Check periods/powers, units, scan range, simulation count/test level, window length and step. See the specific cause in details.
parameterhelp.coco_null: Default: fixed-parameter Gaussian AR(1); rho=0 is white noise. Random spectral peaks are a literature reference model, not a general time-series false-positive guarantee.
parameterhelp.coco_rho: Specify independently of the tested data. Fitting rho to this series does not give an exact test. Default 0; |rho|<1. Replay detrending, FFT and rate scanning on stationary Gaussian AR(1) draws; upstream processing is not replayed.
parameterhelp.coco_null_peaks: 0: count strict local periodogram peaks, excluding DC/Nyquist; otherwise use this count. Random positions and heights, width 2 Rayleigh. No red-noise subtraction; not a replica of all Acycle options.
parameterhelp.coco_simulations: Default 199; minimum p resolution is 1/(B+1). Increase B for final analyses when budget permits; predeclare the target, band and rate grid.
parameterhelp.coco_seed: A fixed seed reproduces the same input and parameters; tasks do not share mutable RNG state. Do not select a seed by its result.
parameterhelp.coco_alpha: Default 0.05; must be at least 1/(B+1). Decide using p<=alpha; the critical value is a plotting aid. After selecting a best rate, use the scan-adjusted or global-scan p value.
parameterhelp.ecoco_window: Full windows only, at least two. Each window must resolve the specified target; adjust the window or target if too short. No automatic resampling.
parameterhelp.ecoco_step: 1 to the window length. At most 512 full windows; an incomplete trailing window is omitted and reported, never padded.
warning.coco_fixed_null: Tests the current input against stationary Gaussian AR(1) with independently specified rho; rho=0 is white noise. No rho fitting or replay of upstream filters. Calibration requires the declared null; detrending=none also requires zero mean.
warning.coco_random_reference: Random-peak p values compare with a reference spectrum of 2-Rayleigh half-sine peaks at random positions/heights, not arbitrary red-noise data. Automatic peak count comes from the observed spectrum; no red-noise background removal.
warning.coco_scan_test: Pointwise p is for a predeclared individual rate. Scan-adjusted/global p uses each replicate’s maximum positive correlation over this fixed grid; it does not cover parameter searches, multiple files or a sliding map. Significance does not prove astronomical causation or give a rate confidence interval.
warning.ecoco_descriptive: The eCOCO map is descriptive local spectral matching, with no pointwise or whole-map significance. Best candidates are selected independently per window and may jump; no age model is generated or smoothed.
warning.ecoco_tail: An incomplete trailing window was omitted; see unused_tail_samples in the report. No edge-window padding or extrapolation.
progress.coco_monte_carlo: Computing targets and Monte Carlo reference
parameterhelp.peak_relative_prominence: Default 0.1% of the full spectrum power range. Suppresses tiny tail oscillations; lowering it preserves weaker peaks. 0 disables this amplitude filter. Not a statistical significance test. Absolute and relative thresholds both apply; roundoff-sized fluctuations are excluded.

methodhelp.sine_source: Sine signal with an optional linear trend; zero slope gives a pure sine.
parameterhelp.example_axis: Select the published age or composite-depth column without interpolation. Source citation, chronology and omitted-row counts are saved in Parameters and provenance. Resample explicitly for methods requiring uniform spacing.
warning.example_spacing: Published sample spacing is preserved and is not strictly uniform. Resample explicitly before methods that require uniform input; no processing step was inserted automatically.
warning.example_missing: Rows missing the selected X or Y were omitted; counts are recorded in provenance. All remaining values and order are unchanged.
warning.example_chronology: Uses the original published chronology, including author tuning or interpolation. Orbital agreement is not independent validation of the age model.

methodhelp.synthetic_orbital:
Synthetic record combining five precession terms, five eccentricity difference-frequency terms, variable sedimentation rate and AR1 noise; not an actual orbital solution or age determination.
Algorithm reference: AstroGeoFit 1.1 (GPL-3.0-or-later). Depth template: PANGAEA.817206 (CC BY 3.0).
warning.synthetic_model: Synthetic proxy with variable sedimentation, not a physical orbital solution; ages are relative. AR1 is sample-indexed; proxy standardizes clean+noise.
warning.synthetic_irregular: Template depth and resulting age are irregular. Explicitly resample for methods requiring uniform sampling.
warning.synthetic_undersampled: Some age gaps exceed half the shortest harmonic period. Increase sampling or reduce thickness.
diagnostic.SYNTHETIC_ORBITAL.suggestion: Check ordered sedimentation bounds, grid and noise parameters; see details for the exact reason.
parameterhelp.synthetic_grid: ODP 1260 uses 2679 original irregular depth positions, not measured Fe. Custom grid is uniform in depth.
parameterhelp.synthetic_start_m: Only for a custom uniform grid. Relative age starts at zero at the first depth.
parameterhelp.synthetic_span_m: Positive depth span; end = start + thickness.
parameterhelp.synthetic_count: 32–100000; sparse sampling may alias high-frequency precession terms.
parameterhelp.synthetic_seed: Same seed and all parameters reproduce the result. Aster streams differ from NumPy for the same seed.
parameterhelp.synthetic_realization: Change the index to generate another realization; changing output or repeating preview does not redraw it.
parameterhelp.synthetic_rate_min: Must be below the maximum. Eight inverse-rate knots are smoothed, interpolated and clipped.
parameterhelp.synthetic_rate_max: cm/kyr; inverse rate 0.1/rate is Myr/m, integrated over depth by the trapezoidal rule.
parameterhelp.synthetic_snr: Clean variance = 1, noise variance = 1/SNR. The sum is standardized again to form proxy. Not a significance threshold.
parameterhelp.synthetic_rho: Indexed by adjacent samples with 256 burn-in points; not a fixed-distance/time correlation on irregular grids.
